title: Bruno - The Git-Native API Client
excerpt: Bruno is the Git-native API client for REST, GraphQL, gRPC and Websocket. A local and open-source solution to Postman. Fast, developer-first, and no cloud syncing.
content_html:
Developer First

An API client, not a platform

Bruno is the open-source challenger to bloated, cloud-locked "platforms". A devtool should be extensible and work with the rest of your stack, not against it.

Open-source & endlessly extensible

OpenCollection YAML, human-readable and diff-friendly

Runs in your IDE, terminal, and agents

Secure & Local

Your data never leaves your machine

No cloud sync. No account. No login. We have zero visibility into your requests, and we're not training AI models on your data. Share only when you choose, through Git.

SOC 2 Type II

Independently audited
